title: As a First Resort
start: Talk to Chief Tess in the centre of Oo'glog.

ironman.t: Partial completion of Big Chompy Bird Hunting
Having started Haunted Mine for access to the Abandoned Mine for a bronze spear on level 2 or
The Lost Tribe for bone spear or
33 quest points for Scavvo's Rune Store access in Champions' Guild or
Tai Bwo Wannai Trio for Tamayu's Spear Stall or
99 Attack OR 99 Strength OR a combined 130 levels in Attack and Strength for Warriors' Guild access

items.t: Teasing stick (Unless you are buying the 8 larupia furs from the grand exchange)
Four spears of the same type (bone spears work; poisoned spears and leaf-bladed spears do not work)
15-30 eucalyptus logs (If you don't make any mistakes in the logic section, 20 is more than enough)

Available to be caught in the ogre chompy hunting area, which requires partial completion of Big Chompy Bird Hunting. If hunting, remember to bring an ogre comp or a plain ogre bow, ogre arrows and ogre bellows
8 stripy feathers (available from the tropical wagtails in the hunting area to the north of Oo'glog)
4 wolf bones (available from killing the wolves outside Oo'glog)
8 larupia furs (tatty or perfect, available from pit-fall hunting Larupia in the hunting area to the north of Oo'glog)
Each of the following plants found near Oo'glog:
Some logs of any kind for traps

recommended.t: Activated the Oo'glog lodestone (Fastest method of travel)
Master archaeologist's outfit or Archaeology teleport to Chief Tess
Runes for the South Feldip Hills Teleport (1 air rune, 1 water rune and 1 law rune)
A ring of duelling to teleport to the Warforge Dig Site, a short distance west from Oo'glog
The Fairy ring AKS is north of Oo'glog
The Spirit Tree at South Feldip Hills Teleport

kills.t: None, but lower-levelled players should avoid the level 11 wolves outside the city.

rewards.t: A mixture of 4 items, either caskets or oysters
Access to the Oo'glog Hunter area
Access to the platypus summoning pet (requires 10 Summoning).
If you release your pet in the spot you released the others during the quest you will receive another casket or oyster
Access to the Fresh Meat shop
Ability to travel to Oo'glog using the charter ships
Ability to create robust glass and crystal glass
Access to decanting five and six dose flasks into other flasks or vials (talk to Teplin Macagan)

steps.t: Head to Oo'glog and talk to Chief Tess. [Chat: 1 What exactly is going on around here? › Accept › 1 So about this 'business venture'.. › 1 Can I help at all?]

Talk to Balnea in the Oo'glog bank. [Chat: 1 Um, yes. So, what's going on around here? › 2 What's the problem? › 1 Okay, I'll bite. Tell me more. › 1 But of course! › 1 Well, why not? I've nothing better to do. › 1 Sure thing.]
Talk to Chargurr north of the bank. [Chat: 1 I think I could get that stuff for you.]
Talk to Chargurr with 8 achey tree logs and 10 eucalyptus logs in the backpack to add them to the fire pit.
Talk to Chargurr. [Chat: 2 Fine, I'll get some spears for you]
Give her four spears. [Chat: 2 Yes, I'd like to give 4 spears to Chargurr.]
Talk to Chargurr. [Chat: 2 But of course! I'll bring you some chompy birds.]
Use two raw chompies on Chargurr.
Talk to Chargurr.
Light the fire pit.
Talk to Chargurr.
Talk to Balnea located in the bank. [Chat: 1 Right-ho. I'll go and see Snurgh at the hotel and 'transition' away.]
Talk to Snurgh who is in the easternmost building of Oo'glog. [Chat: 1 Sure, I'll bring you some feathers.]
Give her 8 stripy feathers.

sub.t: You can obtain the feathers using a bird snare to catch tropical wagtail in the Feldip Hunter area, north of the Oo'glog lodestone.

steps.t: Talk to Balnea. [Chat: 1 You're going to ask me to go to the salon, right? › 1 Yeah, sure, I'll go to the salon.]
Talk to Kringk in the building east of the bank. [Chat: 2 Why, sure, I'd be happy to help.]
Give her 4 wolf bones and 8 larupia furs. [Chat: 1 You sure can!]
Talk to Balnea.
Talk to Seegud in the building north-east of the bank.
Head north-east of Seegud to the thermal spring.
Use a pile of eucalyptus logs and a tansymum, on the fire pit nearby.
Light the fire pit. The insects won't disperse.
Talk to Seegud. [Chat: 2 I think I'm a little stuck. › 1 Can you explain what I should be doing again?]
Head back to the spring and talk to Snarrk.
In the worst case, you need 5 piles of logs and 1 of each plant for the next step.

Move to the thermal bath, north-east of Seegud. There is 'a pile of long brown and yellow egg-shaped stones'. This fire pit requires a pile of eucalyptus logs and one of the five plants in order to disperse the insects. By trial and error, determine which plant is needed for this pool and represents the 'yellow egg-shaped' stones. If done correctly, the swarm of insects above the pool will vanish completely.
In the worst case, you need 4 piles of logs, 4 plants for yellow egg-shaped stone, and 1 of each other plant for the next step.

Move to the mud bath to the east. There is 'a pile of long brown, red sphere and yellow egg-shaped stones'. This fire pit requires eucalyptus logs and two plants. The primary plant of this pool is the same as the plant used at the thermal bath. Figure out the secondary plant by using any of the other four unused plants, until the correct combination is discovered.
In the worst case, you need 3 piles of logs and 3 plants for red sphere stone, 1 of each other plant (except for yellow egg-shaped stone) for the next step.

Move to the salt-water spring west of the thermal bath. There is 'a pile of long brown, red sphere and green gumdrop stones'. This fire pit requires eucalyptus logs and two plants. Be sure to use the secondary plant from the mud bath as the primary plant for this pool. Find the secondary plant by using the three remaining herbs until the correct one is found.
In the worst case, you need 2 piles of logs and 2 plants for green gumdrop stone, 1 of each other plant (except for yellow egg-shaped and red sphere stones) for the next step.

Head west to the yellow sulphur spring. There is 'a pile of long brown, purple tall and green gumdrop stones'. This fire pit requires eucalyptus logs and two plants. Use the secondary plant for the salt-water spring as the primary plant for this spring. One of the two remaining herbs will be the secondary plant, so try them both.
You need 1 pile of logs, 1 plant for red sphere stone, 1 plant for purple tall stone, and 1 unused plant for the next step.

Head to the Bandos pool. There is 'a pile of long brown, red sphere, purple tall and orange squarish stones'. This fire pit requires eucalyptus logs and three plants. Use the secondary plant from the mud bath, the secondary plant from the sulphur pool and the unused herb.
Drop all primweeds and stinkblooms to free up your backpack spaces.
p: Chargurr with her finished concessionary services

steps.t: Keep all other unused plants as you will need them in the next task.
After all of the bugs are taken care of, talk to Seegud.
Talk to Balnea. [Chat: 1 Sure, anything to avoid talking to you for a while.]
Talk to Chief Tess. [Chat: 1 Talk about As a First Resort quest. › 1 I know how to smoke a trap to remove my scent.]
Head to the salt-water spring.
Use the deadfall traps to catch diseased kebbits. To bait the trap, use fever grass on it, then light a fever grass from the inventory and move around.

sub.t: Catch two from the western and eastern side.

steps.t: Do this until all four kebbits are caught.
Set up a bird snare west of the bank.
Light a tansymum from the inventory and move around.
Do this until all birds are caught.
Head west of Chief Tess and the sulphur spring.
Set up a box trap.
Burn lavender from the inventory and move around the area.
Once the box shakes, check the trap.
When all four platypodes are caught, head to the north-east corner of the village and release them next to the plants in the water.
p: Snurgh with the "comfsy pillows for little, softy human heads".

steps.t: Dismiss any followers before continuing.
Talk to Balnea and do not skip the cutscene.
Quest complete!
p: A crowd eagerly waits for the opening
The Wise Old Man enjoying a spa
Oo'glog has become a bustling resort spa!
A player jumping in a spa
Releasing the platypodes into the swamp
